ShopifyCustomers.Description: Customers of the connected Shopify store, copied in by the effortless-node-shopify seed (a sync and Shopify webhooks keep them current). Shopify is the source of these rows: change them in Shopify.

schema.name: ShopifyCustomerId
schema.Description: Shopify's numeric customer id (the tail of gid://shopify/Customer/<id>).

schema.name: Email
schema.Description: The customer's email address, when they gave one.

schema.name: FirstName
schema.Description: Given name.

schema.name: LastName
schema.Description: Family name.

schema.name: OrdersCount
schema.Description: How many orders Shopify counts for this customer.

schema.name: TotalSpent
schema.Description: Lifetime amount spent, in the shop's currency.

schema.name: CurrencyCode
schema.Description: Currency of TotalSpent.

schema.name: State
schema.Description: Shopify's account state: DISABLED, INVITED, ENABLED or DECLINED.

schema.name: ShopifyUpdatedAt
schema.Description: When Shopify last changed this customer.

schema.name: Name
schema.Description: Display label for this customer.

schema.name: IsRepeatCustomer
schema.Description: True when the customer has ordered more than once.

schema.name: CountOfShopifyOrders
schema.Description: Orders in this database placed by this customer (OrdersCount is Shopify's own count).

ShopifyOrders.Description: Orders of the connected Shopify store, copied in by the effortless-node-shopify seed. Shopify is the source of these rows.

schema.name: ShopifyOrderId
schema.Description: Shopify's numeric order id (the tail of gid://shopify/Order/<id>).

schema.name: OrderName
schema.Description: The order number as the shop shows it, for example #1001.

schema.name: ShopifyCustomer
schema.Description: The customer who placed the order. Empty for a guest checkout.

schema.name: Email
schema.Description: The email address on the order.

schema.name: FinancialStatus
schema.Description: Shopify's payment status: PAID, PENDING, REFUNDED and so on.

schema.name: FulfillmentStatus
schema.Description: Shopify's fulfillment status: FULFILLED, UNFULFILLED, PARTIALLY_FULFILLED and so on.

schema.name: TotalPrice
schema.Description: The order total in the shop's currency.

schema.name: CurrencyCode
schema.Description: Currency of TotalPrice.

schema.name: ProcessedAt
schema.Description: When the order was placed.

schema.name: ShopifyUpdatedAt
schema.Description: When Shopify last changed this order.

schema.name: Name
schema.Description: Display label for this order.

schema.name: IsOpenForFulfillment
schema.Description: True until Shopify says the order is FULFILLED.

schema.name: CustomerIsRepeat
schema.Description: Whether the customer who placed this order is a repeat customer, looked up.

ShopifyProducts.Description: Products of the connected Shopify store, copied in by the effortless-node-shopify seed. Shopify is the source of these rows.

schema.name: ShopifyProductId
schema.Description: Shopify's numeric product id (the tail of gid://shopify/Product/<id>).

schema.name: Title
schema.Description: The product's title.

schema.name: Handle
schema.Description: The product's URL handle.

schema.name: Status
schema.Description: ACTIVE, DRAFT or ARCHIVED.

schema.name: Vendor
schema.Description: Who makes or supplies it.

schema.name: ProductType
schema.Description: The shop's own product type.

schema.name: TotalInventory
schema.Description: Units in stock across all variants and locations.

schema.name: PriceMin
schema.Description: The lowest variant price.

schema.name: PriceMax
schema.Description: The highest variant price.

schema.name: CurrencyCode
schema.Description: Currency of the prices.

schema.name: ShopifyUpdatedAt
schema.Description: When Shopify last changed this product.

schema.name: Name
schema.Description: Display label for this product.

schema.name: IsOnSale
schema.Description: True when the product is ACTIVE.
